title: Browser origin is determined by protocol, host and port
summary: Common HTTP(S) sources are judged by scheme, host, and port. Different paths can still have the same origin, but different ports can have different origins.
applies: Browser interpretation of URLs, cookies, and origins
detail: https://example.test:443/a and https://example.test/b correspond to the same default port. Changing the same host from http to https changes the source.
boundary: Same site and same origin are different judgments; some URLs such as data: correspond to opaque sources.
relevance: Distinguish between merely switching paths and true cross-origin requests when reading browser logs.
